node.text: 已解出 45 题 · 作文范文 2 篇

21. Which team will play the most games at the stadium this month? A. Washington Commanders. B. Los Angeles Rams. C. Los Angeles Chargers. D. New Orleans Saints. 答案：B 原文明确说Rams每个赛季在此主场作战场次最多。
22. Which hotel is the nearest to the stadium? A. Sonder Lum Hotel. B. The Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles. C. The H Hotel Los Angeles. D. The Renaissance LA Airport Hotel 答案：A Sonder Lum Hotel就在体育场街对面，距离最近。
23. What do you need to do if you want to park at the stadium? A. Call the parking staff. B. Prepay the parking fee. C. Obtain a parking pass. D. Choose a parking zone. 答案：C 原文建议通过ParkWhiz提前购买停车通行证。
24. What does Kevin usually do to get the meaning of a word? A. Use electronic devices. B. Consult a paper dictionary. C. Guess from the context. D. Turn to his English teacher. 答案：B Kevin和作者一起翻阅纸质词典查词。
25. How did Kevin feel while looking up the word in the dictionary? A. Annoyed. B. Disappointed. C. Encouraged. D. Astonished. 答案：D 他对一页竟有这么多同前缀单词感到震惊又敬畏。
26. What can we learn about the author's first dictionary? A. It helped her through the college. B. It was given to Kevin as a gift. C. It bore witness to her efforts. D. It was a valuable limited edition. 答案：C 她在词典上做标记，见证了学词的付出。
27. What has the author come to realize about learning? A. It is never too late to start. B. Motivation is what really matters. C. Children need role models. D. Dictionaries are still a useful tool. 答案：B 她强调自己是为体验而做，兴趣动机最重要。
28. What does the new study imply regarding oaks and sweetgums? A. They affect the growth of other trees. B. They absorb less carbon than expected. C. They harm people's health indirectly. D. They raise the local temperature slowly. 答案：C 橡树和枫香树释放的异戊二烯会间接形成臭氧危害健康。
29. Which of the following may Commane suggest based on their study? A. Cutting down the isoprene-producing trees. B. Suspending tree-planting for a few decades. C. Changing the species of trees in new plantings. D. Removing isoprene released by existing trees. 答案：C Commane表示种树要谨慎，暗示应改变树种选择。
30. What does the underlined phrase "oblivious to" in paragraph 5 mean? A. Honest about. B. Unaware of. C. Related to. D. Optimistic about. 答案：B oblivious to意为“未意识到”。
31. What would Auyeung probably advocate? A. Reducing car use in daily life. B. Providing animals with new habitats. C. Controlling population growth. D. Doing more research on the problem. 答案：A Auyeung认为问题在汽车排放，应减少用车。
32. What does the study imply regarding oaks and sweetgums? A. They attract more insects. B. They absorb more carbon. C. They cause higher temperatures. D. They need the same care. 答案：C 研究显示树木释放物会推高夏季臭氧与温度相关污染。
33. According to the study, which group was more likely to think beyond daily life? A. They are mostly non-native. B. They are evenly distributed. C. They are resistant to pests. D. They are increasing rapidly. 答案：B 原文说美组在抽象思维上得分更高，更关注人生大问题。
34. Why did the researchers ask about the participants' feelings? A. To compare different tree species. B. To discuss a study on urban trees. C. To explain how to plant trees. D. To argue against cutting trees. 答案：B 研究者借参与者感受来讨论城市树木这一研究。
35. What does the study encourage people to do? A. Visit galleries more often. B. Spend less time on screens. C. Buy handmade ceramics. D. Develop their critical thinking. 答案：A 研究鼓励人们多接触艺术之美以拓展思维。
36. 36 ______. 答案：E 空格处引出博物馆作为学习场所的总起句。
37. 37 ______ Virtual guides can respond in dozens of languages and adjust their tone to suit each listener, whether a young student or a lifelong art lover. 答案：F 后文讲虚拟导览多语言、可调语气，对应AI聊天机器人取代传统语音导览。
38. 38________ Moreover, it can predict how a fragile painting may age over the years, allowing experts to step in before any visible damage appears. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：A 后文讲预测画作老化，属AI用于修复，故选A。
39. 39________ For instance, a curious child and a trained art expert standing before the same painting might each receive a completely different guided tour. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：D 后文举例不同观众获得不同导览，说明个性化推荐。
40. 40________ Strict rules are therefore needed to ensure that every visitor's privacy is fully protected. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：B 后文讲需要严格规则保护隐私，故前句谈数据滥用风险。
41. The 41______ that people only really knew Ohio for the three C's - Cleveland, Cincinnati, or Columbus (not Cortland!) - came quickly when I decided to go to school in central Pennsylvania. A. fantasy B. prejudice C. realization D. expectation 答案：C “意识到”人们只知俄亥俄三C，符合语境。
42. Half of my peers didn't even realize I lived a 42 ______ three and a half hours away. A. only B. indeed C. still D. even 答案：A “仅仅三个半小时车程”，only符合语义。
43. The 43 ______ are never-ending. A. tests B. questions C. games D. debates 答案：B 后文列举各种提问，故为“问题没完没了”。
44. I was a unicorn in their eyes, a 44 ______ Or, on second thought, maybe just a country hick. A. success B. victim C. novelty D. problem 答案：C “novelty”意为新奇事物，与“乡巴佬”形成对照。
45. As I grow older, I'm more and more 45 ______ for my small town roots. A. thankful B. hopeful C. suitable D. reliable 答案：A be thankful for对……心怀感激。
46. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. dream B. lie C. bear D. complain 答案：D complain about抱怨，符合“嫌无聊”语境。
47. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. therefore B. however C. instead D. otherwise 答案：B 前后转折，用however。
48. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. touring B. challenging C. leaving D. protecting 答案：C “离开”小镇后才意识到多爱它。
49. For one, the pace of life isn't anxiety provoking and people really 49 ______ connecting to each other. A. value B. admit C. fear D. remember 答案：A value connecting to each other重视彼此联系。
50. That means that you do more than just talk to your next door neighbors - in a lot of cases, they're truly so 50 ______ of your family. A. advantage B. example C. owner D. extension 答案：D an extension of your family是固定表达，意为延伸。
51. So much of this 51______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52______ is a critical part of the culture. A. lifestyle B. landscape C. procedure D. personality 答案：A 这种“生活方式”围绕户外活动展开。
52. So much of this 51______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52______ is a critical part of the culture. A. findings B. surroundings C. belongings D. greetings 答案：B 留意“周围环境”是文化的重要部分。
53. As I move through my college years, I 53 ______ the visits to my little hometown. A. give up B. put off C. face up to D. look forward to 答案：D look forward to期待回小镇的探访。
54. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：B grateful for the example感恩成长中的榜样。
55. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：C draw on my roots汲取家乡根基的力量。
56. It is also common for them 56 ____ (hold) on traditional Chinese holidays such as the Spring Festival, also known as the Chinese New Year, and Mid-Autumn Festival, as well as other local festivals. 答案：to hold it is common for sb to do sth结构。
57. The exact dates and 57 ____ (frequent) of daji vary from region to region. 答案：frequency 与dates并列需名词，frequent变frequency。
58. Dajis evolved from the folk custom of trading goods, which can be traced back to 58 ____ Han Dynasty (202 B.C.-A.D. 答案：the Han Dynasty前加定冠词the。
59. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ____ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ____ (necessity). 答案：were 主语为复数且叙述过去，用were。
60. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ____ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ____ (necessity). 答案：necessities daily necessities日常必需品，用复数。
61. They would trade their surplus items 61 ____ the goods they needed. 答案：for trade A for B以物易物，用for。
62. 62____ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63____ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：Drawn 过去分词作状语，表被动。
63. 62____ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63____ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：grabbing 现在分词作伴随状语，与hurry并列。
64. Before 64 ____ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ____ (cheap)than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：heading before后接动名词。
65. Before 64 ____ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ____ (cheap)than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：cheaper much修饰比较级，用cheaper。
